footer.tagline: A free educational tool for the Slovak digital world.

banner.title: 🍪 Cookies and privacy
banner.description: We've added an option for authors to collect responses for educational purposes (opt-in, with an author password). We've updated our privacy policy. We use necessary storage for the test to function; optional categories (analytics, marketing) are only enabled with your consent.

dialog.title: Cookie settings
dialog.description_prefix: Choose which storage and processing categories you allow. You can change your selection at any time via the "Cookie settings" link in the page footer. Details are in the

necessary.title: Necessary
necessary.description: Without these the test cannot be completed or its result saved. They cover the anonymous session, anti-cheat protection and storage of your consent. Legal basis: legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Remembers your language, theme and favourite answers for a smoother experience on your next visit.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Anonymised analytics (traffic, completion rates, A/B tests) — helps us improve the test. We don't share anything that could identify you.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.description: Personalised recommendations, retargeting on ad networks and measurement of campaign effectiveness. Not currently used; kept here in case of future expansion.
